name: IEEE Cubing Nepal 2025
information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTU1MDMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--cd5fab2f0a9583192266fe07fa93f6ca1fd38306/IEEE-CS.png) **IEEE Cubing Nepal 2025** is organized in coordination with the **IEEE Computer Society Pulchowk Student Branch Chapter**. This Rubik’s Cube competition welcomes cubers from all around the world to participate, compete, and celebrate their passion for cubing. For more updates on events and activities by the Computer Society Chapter, check out [Pulchowk Computer Society on Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/pulchowkcompsbc/). Please take a look at the other tabs for more details. You can [contact](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IEEECubingNepal2025#60043-contact-info) us for any queries. **First-time participants must bring an ID card with their Date of Birth for identity verification.** **Participants are requested to arrive at least 15 minutes before the end of the scheduled registration time to ensure timely procedures.**
